about: Numbers measured from your own runs on the test set (728 crops, 361,147 labelled pixels). Edit this file after you retrain and the page updates.

rf.label: Random Forest
rf.note: 100 trees, 16 features (11 bands + 5 spectral indices), trained on 761,887 pixels

unet.label: U-Net
unet.note: 3 down-steps, 11 bands in, 30 epochs, best epoch picked on the validation set

validation.note: Random Forest trained on a 200,000-pixel sample, scored on the validation set

ensemble.label: U-Net ensemble
ensemble.note: 5 U-Nets averaged (original, 3 x Dice-loss seeds, 1 wider model). Measured on the test set by analysis_report.py. Oil IoU is worked out from oil recall and precision.
